# IMMUNIZATION OF PATIENTS AGE 65 YEARS OR GREATER

See immunization information pages located at the bottom of this page for other indications, contraindications, and one-time dose orders to listed vaccines.

[Patient vaccine history](orz-gtx-abx-joint-legacy-viewer)

[CDC Recommended Adult Immunization Schedule](orz-gtx-abx-cdc-adult-immunization-schedule)

# Specific vaccine orders for patients age 65 years or greater:

[Haemophilus influenza type b: indicated in asplenia, those undergoing](haemophilus-influenza-type-b-vaccine-information)
splenectomy and HSCT patients. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or refer to the Haemophilus influenza type b vaccine information menu below.

[Hepatitis A: 2 dose series, for those who want protection, or w/additional risk](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-a-vaccine-2-dose-series)
factor or another indication.

[Hepatitis A/B: 3 dose series, for those who want protection, or w/additional](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-a-b-vaccine-3-dose-series)
risk factor or another indication.

[Hepatitis B: 2 dose series, for those who want protection, or w/additional risk](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-b-adjuvanted-vaccine-2-dose-series)
factor or another indication.

[Herpes zoster: 2 dose series.](orz-set-abx-op-zoster-recombinant-vaccine-2-dose-series)

Human papillomavirus: not indicated.

[Influenza: one dose annually.](flu-seasonal-influenza)

Measles, mumps, and rubella: not indicated
[Meningococcal A, C, W and Y: indicated in asplenia, HIV, complement deficiency](meningococcal-conjugate-vaccine-information)
or inhibitor use, travel to endemic countries, microbiologists, and college students. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for asplenia and HIV or refer to the Meningococcal A, C, W and Y vaccine information menu below.

[Meningococcal B: 2 dose series for 19 to 23yrs, and for those w/additional risk](orz-set-abx-op-meningococcal-b-vaccine-2-dose-series)
factor or another indication.

Pneumococcal 20-valent: one dose, administer via clinical reminder.

[Tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis: 3 dose primary series, booster every 10yrs.](orz-set-abx-op-td-tdap-vaccine-3-dose-series)

[Varicella: 2 dose series for those w/additional risk factor or another.](orz-set-abx-op-varicella-vaccine-2-dose-series)
